summary: Dependency resolved from unpinned GitHub source outside the npm registry
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA or tag. On `npm install`, this resolves to whatever bytes the repository's default branch currently returns, with no integrity check and no registry-side scanning, and any lifecycle scripts shipped in that repository will execute on the installer's machine. The content is mutable: the code delivered to installers can change at any time without any new release of raiden-baileys, and control over the source repository translates directly to code execution on every installer. The package is a fork of a WhatsApp library (Baileys), and the pinned-away `libsignal` dependency is a core cryptographic component, so the install-time impact is a full-tree pull of attacker-controllable code into the installer's environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
